reasons: The existing conference_fixture_catalog.py entries are generated microfixtures rather than independently sampled public repositories.
They have no frozen public-population query, canonical repository cluster, public maintenance-record snapshot, or remote commit/tree receipt.
Repeated Agent attempts over those fixtures measure execution repeatability, not population-level generalization.

missing_bundle_inputs: A frozen population snapshot with at least 288 eligible unique public TypeScript Next.js repositories and maintenance records.
A query receipt, eligibility ledger, unpredictable selection seed, and deterministic selection receipt frozen before task authoring.
Exact remote commit/tree, license, package-manifest, dependency-lock, React/Next dependency, TypeScript target, source archive, and public-record receipts for every selected repository.
A treatment-blind public task, public executable regression test, and separate mode-0600 host verifier and label for every selected repository.
Pinned-runtime receipts proving base failure and frozen-gold success for both public tests and host verifiers.
A prospective power simulation over the completed frame and an independently reviewed judge validation packet.
scientific_reason: Generating variants of the 24 local fixtures would create pseudo-replication. The powered estimand requires real public maintenance provenance and independent repository clusters; attempts and generated cases cannot substitute for those units.
next_action: Acquire and review the public population in trusted preparation, freeze the seed and selection order, qualify every public test and host verifier, then require validate_conference_sampling_frame_v1.py to emit status=ready before creating either Study spec.
